notes: New in 2.3.9: You can now tap Test while adding a new AI key, before saving. In Settings → Brain (AI model) → AI keys → Add key, fill in the type, address, model and key, then tap Test. It checks the key and shows what the model can do, without saving anything. If you leave the model empty, Test shows the models this key can use: tap one to put it in the Model field, then tap Test again. When it works, tap Add key to keep it. Test also works on a saved key you are changing: it tests what you typed (if the Key field is empty, it uses the saved key). For OpenRouter, choose "Other OpenAI-compatible"; the address is https://openrouter.ai/api/v1.
